uutiset.t: AI-Linked Stocks Take Off After Nvidia Restores Jensen Huang
uutiset.s: Shares of companies tied to artificial intelligence surged Monday after Nvidia Corp. reinstated Jensen Huang as president and chief executive officer, effective immediately.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Shares Fluctuate as AI Sector Rallies on Nvidia CEO Return
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares struggled for direction in early Monday trading, with the artificial intelligence lab lagging behind the rest of the sector’s rebound following the reinstatement of Nvidia Corp.’s Jensen Huang.

uutiset.t: US Business Activity Expands at Slowest Pace in Four Months
uutiset.s: US business activity expanded at the slowest pace in four months as high prices, shipping delays and capacity constraints weighed on factory owners and service providers.

uutiset.t: Stellantis Pulls Out of Auto Racing as CEO Ramps Up Cost Cuts
uutiset.s: Stellantis NV is withdrawing from auto racing, as the car manufacturer pushes ahead with cost cuts and a turnaround plan that’s struggling to win over investors.

uutiset.t: Forint Jumps After Hungary Softens Interest-Rate Guidance
uutiset.s: The Hungarian forint jumped after the central bank softened its monetary policy guidance, citing a more limited room to cut interest rates after a market selloff.

uutiset.t: Hedge Funds’ $1 Billion Arbitrage Win in Cayman Is Under Threat
uutiset.s: Investment firms that reaped a $1 billion award on a bet challenging the $2.59 billion take-private deal for China’s Sina Corp. now face the possibility that they’ll never be paid.

uutiset.t: Stocks Rebound After AI-Driven Correction; Crowdstrike to Buy ZScaler
uutiset.s: US equity futures rebound from a rout in the AI trade that sent the S&P 500 into a correction. uutiset.t: Citi Wealth CIO Moore Says ‘Going to Wait It Out’ on Market Selloff
uutiset.s: Kate Moore, chief investment officer at Citi Wealth, says she’s not ready to call an “all clear” on markets, but doesn’t see anything to make her cut back her equity exposure. She speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: US Oil Refining’s Stellar Run Is Starting to Slow
uutiset.s: Weakening gasoline means profits may have peaked.

uutiset.t: Yardeni Cuts S&P 500 Target After Stock Selloff
uutiset.s: Wall Street strategist Ed Yardeni cut his S&P 500 Index year-end forecast for the second time in about two months in the wake of a powerful stock selloff that pushed the benchmark into a technical correction. uutiset.t: Brazil’s Real Weakens Past 6 Per Dollar as Selloff Extends
uutiset.s: The Brazilian real tumbled past 6 reais per dollar, extending a post-election selloff fueled by concerns over the country’s fiscal outlook.

uutiset.t: Poland’s IPO Rush Builds as Defense Firms Join Listings Wave
uutiset.s: Poland’s IPO revival is gathering momentum, as companies tied to the country’s record military buildup bolster the listings pipeline.

uutiset.t: Top Cobalt Miner Congo to Ban Exports Again as Prices Fall
uutiset.s: Top cobalt producer Democratic Republic of Congo will reintroduce a ban on exports of the battery metal from the end of the month, in an effort to reverse slumping prices.

uutiset.t: Tech Companies Are Getting More Creative to Raise Billions
uutiset.s: The biggest tech companies are increasingly finding that to borrow the hundreds of billions of dollars they want to fund artificial intelligence investments, they need to get creative.
